title: A plate over every figure
lines: Every figure in The Little Raid now has one plate over its head: health, mana, stars and items.
Stars are bronze, silver or gold. Health and items no longer sit under a figure's feet.

more.head: Also
points: While you plan, a plate shows the health and mana a figure starts the fight with.
Ticks on the health bar mark every 250 health. Past 1,250, they mark every 1,000.
A shield shows in grey after the health.
On the bench, a figure shows only its stars and items.
Damage numbers now start above the plate.
